items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: Who's that? Me, that's myself, Gitar and Matthew Maxey.

ctx.x: Oh, what I get my new heart filled. Oh, baby, I feel my tender up high. Oh, baby, I feel my tender up high.

Oh, baby, I feel my tender up high. One of those songs is probably like that is, they're probably the great multivine work here. Oh yeah, see, they work like they're be cutting wood in the woods. They're probably be cutting chains, pouring cotton, pouring corn, and different other kind of things. It's early in the morning when they're ringing up their plows and things going to work. But mostly occasionally that's mostly a lot of satisfaction to the guys, and to be singing like that. When they be singing mostly…
